rule: region expanded 4 px per side, snapped outward
draw: 1:1 canvas pixels, unscaled, at (106, 629); straight RGBA8, standard source-over above shell.png
alpha_mode: straight alpha. Opaque where the pressed art covers the (previously transparent) square and where it replaces opaque shell pixels; partial alpha only where the pressed render itself is partial over the transparent square. Exact over any runtime background (see checks S2).
shell_dependency: valid only over the v2 shell.png in this package (decoded RGBA8 pixels sha256 be730dcb6fe6597da111661677788a1ea2717a9283f0d652d2820bff26877069); re-render with the shell if the rail/housing art changes
not_skin_json: art-side metadata only; focused.png is not exported (not loaded under v2)
hash_note: pixels_sha256 / shell pixel hash = SHA-256 of decoded RGBA8 pixels (row-major); stable across PNG re-encoding
